nodes.name: account_employee
nodes.description: Local mirror of an auth-service user / job-service team member inside one tenant. It is the identity anchor for every attendance, WFH and leave row in this service (about 45 single-column FKs and 5 composite FKs point at it).

nodes.name: account_role
nodes.description: Local mirror of auth-service roles per tenant, used as an approval assignee type (leave, WFH, attendance adjustment approval chains).

nodes.name: attendance_adjustment_approval_assignee
nodes.description: Who approves at a level: a role, a specific employee, the requester's reporting manager or project manager(s).

nodes.name: attendance_adjustment_approval_config
nodes.description: Per-tenant switchboard for the attendance adjustment approval chain (requires approval, auto-approve if no approver, suppress approver emails).

nodes.name: attendance_adjustment_approval_level
nodes.description: Ordered approval levels of a tenant's adjustment approval chain, with escalation delay per level.

nodes.name: attendance_admin_setting
nodes.description: One row per tenant holding office start and end time (UTC) used as the default working window for attendance summaries.

nodes.name: attendance_attendance
nodes.description: One employee's attendance day (date + day type), grouping raw punches and adjusted punches through two M2M tables.

externalRefs.enforcement: Logical only (no FK): core/utils/models.py:33-35, requests scoped by request.tenant_id (attendance/views/summary.py:66-67)

nodes.name: attendance_attendance_adjusted_time_entries
nodes.description: Links an attendance day to the punches that should replace the raw ones after an approved adjustment.

nodes.name: attendance_attendance_time_entries
nodes.description: Links an attendance day to its raw clock-in/clock-out punches.

nodes.name: attendance_locationaddress
nodes.description: Geo/address snapshot captured with a clock-in or clock-out punch. Each row belongs to at most one attendance_timeentry row (OneToOne from the time entry side).

nodes.name: attendance_timeentry
nodes.description: One punch (clock-in or clock-out) or one adjustment-generated punch. Linked to its day via attendance_attendance_time_entries (raw punches) or attendance_attendance_adjusted_time_entries (approved adjustments).

nodes.name: attendance_timeentryadjustmentlog
nodes.description: Employee request to correct clock-in/clock-out for a past date, with approval workflow state (pending, approved, rejected, cancelled) and escalation level.

externalRefs.enforcement: Logical only (no FK): attendance/tasks.py:1050-1053 filters by auth-service active tenants

nodes.name: attendance_wfhaccrualsetting
nodes.description: One accrual configuration per WFH policy: yearly quota or unlimited, immediate vs periodic accrual, frequency, per-period amount and per-month/quarter/half-year overrides.

nodes.name: attendance_wfhapprovalassignee
nodes.description: Who approves at a level: a role, a specific employee, the reporting manager or the project manager.

nodes.name: attendance_wfhapprovalconfig
nodes.description: Approval chain header for a WFH policy: whether approval is required, auto-approve when no approver, suppress approver notifications.

nodes.name: attendance_wfhapprovallevel
nodes.description: Ordered levels of a WFH approval chain with optional skip-after-N-days escalation.

nodes.name: attendance_wfhautoapprovenotifyassignee
nodes.description: Who is notified when a WFH request is auto-approved (role, employee, reporting manager, project manager).

nodes.name: attendance_wfhpriornoticesetting
nodes.description: Prior-notice rules of a WFH policy: requests of at least min_wfh_days need calendar_days_notice calendar days and working_days_needed working days of notice.

nodes.name: audit_log_entry_actor
nodes.description: Records which Employee made an audited change, because auditlog's own actor FK targets Django auth users which this service does not use.

nodes.name: auditlog_logentry
nodes.description: Change history (create/update/delete) of the 20 leave configuration models in MODEL_SERIALIZER_MAP (leave/utils/audit_config.py:23-44), shown by the audit history API.

externalRefs.target: generic (20 leave configuration tables via content_type_id and object_pk)

nodes.name: auth_group
nodes.description: Django permission groups (admin only).

nodes.name: auth_group_permissions
nodes.description: Group to permission link (admin only).

nodes.name: auth_permission
nodes.description: Model permissions created by post_migrate for every model.

nodes.name: auth_user
nodes.description: Django user accounts. Only used for Django admin login; API auth is token based against auth-service (attendance_service_django/settings.py:142-152).

nodes.name: auth_user_groups
nodes.description: User to group link (admin only).

nodes.name: auth_user_user_permissions
nodes.description: User to permission link (admin only).

nodes.name: django_admin_log
nodes.description: Django admin change history.

nodes.name: django_content_type
nodes.description: Registry of installed models; populated by the post_migrate signal.

nodes.name: django_migrations
nodes.description: Records applied migrations (171 project migration files plus framework ones).

nodes.name: django_session
nodes.description: Database session store (default SESSION_ENGINE).

nodes.name: employee_leave_balance_history
nodes.description: Append-only ledger of every leave balance change (credit/debit/inactive) with a snapshot of the resulting balance, the reason, cycle and optional links to the leave request, actor and accrual log.

nodes.name: employee_wfh_type_override
nodes.description: Per-employee decision for a WFH type; currently only used to disable a type for an otherwise eligible employee (absence of a row means allowed).

nodes.name: holiday_holiday
nodes.description: Tenant holiday calendar. Used to exclude holidays from working-day, leave duration, WFH and punctuality calculations.

nodes.name: holiday_region
nodes.description: Platform-wide (not tenant scoped) holiday template region, for example a country. Tenants copy its holidays into holiday_holiday.

nodes.name: holiday_regionholiday
nodes.description: Holiday entries of a platform-wide region template.

nodes.name: leave_accruallog
nodes.description: One row per accrual credit applied by the accrual engine (old/new value, amount, type, reason, optional expiry); also used as an idempotency guard ("already allocated").

nodes.name: leave_accrualratebytenure
nodes.description: Tenure slabs: days per year once an employee reaches N years from joining.

nodes.name: leave_approvalassignee
nodes.description: Who approves at a level: a role, a specific employee, the reporting manager or project managers.

nodes.name: leave_approvallevel
nodes.description: Ordered approval level inside either a leave approval chain or an encashment approval chain (polymorphic via two nullable FKs).

nodes.name: leave_autoapprovenotifyassignee
nodes.description: People to notify when a request is auto-approved under an approval config.

nodes.name: leave_bulkuploadlog
nodes.description: Tracks a bulk upload (leave type, plan or balance spreadsheet) tied to a File: category, processing flag, error.

nodes.name: leave_compoffcreditrequest
nodes.description: Employee request to be credited comp-off days for a worked period, with approval workflow and a credited flag once the balance is topped up.

nodes.name: leave_compoffcreditrequest_attachments
nodes.description: Links comp-off requests to proof-of-work files.

nodes.name: leave_employeeleavebalance
nodes.description: Current leave balance per employee, leave type and leave plan (allocated, remaining, used). One active row per (employee, leave type, plan) by convention; older rows are kept with is_active=false.

nodes.name: leave_employeeleavelog
nodes.description: The leave request (application) itself, despite the "log" name: dates, duration, approval/rejection/cancel state and actors, notes, notify list.

nodes.name: leave_employeeleavelog_attachments
nodes.description: Links leave requests to uploaded proof files.

nodes.name: leave_employeeyearendbalance
nodes.description: Per-employee row inside a year-end run, parent of per-leave-type transactions.

nodes.name: leave_file
nodes.description: Metadata for files stored in S3 (leave proofs, comp-off proofs, WFH proofs, bulk uploads); key is derived from tenant, uploader, file_id and name.

nodes.name: leave_leaveaccrualconfig
nodes.description: Accrual panel for one plan/type config: yearly quota, accrual frequency and amounts, comp-off request rules, expiry, attendance-based restrictions, negative balance and tenure-based accrual switches.

nodes.name: leave_leaveaccrualconfig_restricted_leave_types
nodes.description: Leave types whose usage restricts accrual for this accrual config (attendance-based restriction).

nodes.name: leave_leaveapplicationconfig
nodes.description: "Applying leave" panel: half/quarter day, prior notice switch, backdating limits, same-day cutoff, balance rounding, comment requirement, floater and calendar-day counting.

nodes.name: leave_leaveapplicationrestrictionconfig
nodes.description: "Leave application restrictions" panel: self-apply block, attachment rule, early/future application, same-year usage, balance and combination restrictions, minimum request size.

nodes.name: leave_leaveapplicationrestrictionconfig_cannot_be_availed_w3b41
nodes.description: Leave types that cannot be combined with this leave type in adjacent requests.

nodes.name: leave_leaveapplicationrestrictionconfig_unavailable_types
nodes.description: Leave types whose remaining balance makes this leave type unavailable.

nodes.name: leave_leaveapprovalconfig
nodes.description: Approval chain header for a plan/type config, either for regular leave or for comp-off credit requests.

nodes.name: leave_leavecarryforwardconfig
nodes.description: Year-end carry-forward strategy for a plan/type config, optional target leave type and expiry.

nodes.name: leave_leaveencashmentapprovalconfig
nodes.description: Intended approval header for encashment requests (levels in leave_approvallevel).

nodes.name: leave_leaveencashmentapprover
nodes.description: Intended assignees for encashment approval levels; uses plain UUID columns, the pattern leave_approvalassignee abandoned in 0041.

nodes.name: leave_leaveencashmentconfig
nodes.description: Encashment rules for a plan/type config: allowed or not, frequency limit, allowed months, manager application, fixed or percentage mode.

nodes.name: leave_leaveencashmentthreshold
nodes.description: Threshold rules: when balance exceeds X, encash up to Y days.

nodes.name: leave_leaveplan
nodes.description: Named leave policy per tenant; employees are assigned to one plan and each plan holds one configuration per leave type.

nodes.name: leave_leaveplanleavetypeconfig
nodes.description: Hub row for one leave type inside one leave plan. Holds forward OneToOne/FK pointers to each config panel (accrual, application rules, approvals, sandwich, encashment, carry-forward, probation, notice period).

nodes.name: leave_leavepriornoticerule
nodes.description: Prior-notice rule rows: requests of at least N days need M calendar days notice and K working days.

nodes.name: leave_leavequota
nodes.description: Original per-leave-type quota and carry-forward settings by employee type. Superseded in practice by the per-plan accrual and year-end config tables.

nodes.name: leave_leavesandwichpolicyconfig
nodes.description: Sandwich policy: whether weekly offs/holidays adjacent to or between leave days are counted as leave, and clubbing across leave types.

nodes.name: leave_leavetype
nodes.description: Tenant catalogue of leave types (code, name, category, eligibility restrictions, colour). Every plan configuration, balance, log, comp-off request and year-end transaction hangs off a row here.

nodes.name: leave_leavetypeyearendtransaction
nodes.description: Per employee and leave type year-end figures: balance, carry forward, encashable, expired, quota, negative-balance treatment, carry target type.

nodes.name: leave_leaveusagecountrule
nodes.description: "How many times this leave can be taken" rules (N times per month/year/tenure).

nodes.name: leave_leaveusagelimitconfig
nodes.description: "Leave usage limits" panel: max consecutive days, monthly cap, allowed request date range, minimum gap, instance limits.

nodes.name: leave_noticeperiodaccrualslab
nodes.description: Days granted depending on which day of the month the exit date falls (strategy range).

nodes.name: leave_noticeperiodleaveconfig
nodes.description: Notice-period rules: accrual proration strategy on exit, notice extension per leave, encashment block, whether leave is allowed during notice.

nodes.name: leave_probationaccrualslab
nodes.description: Slabs granting days depending on which day of the month probation ends.

nodes.name: leave_probationfirstmonthslab
nodes.description: First-month proration slabs by joining-day range.

nodes.name: leave_probationleaveconfig
nodes.description: Probation rules for a plan/type config: first-month proration, accrual during probation, application waiting period, cap during probation, encashment block, carry-over at probation end.

nodes.name: leave_request_action_log
nodes.description: Append-only audit trail of state-changing actions on a leave request (approve, reject, undo, partial_cancel) with from/to status, actor and role, and for undo the original action and actor.

nodes.name: leave_yearendprocessing
nodes.description: One year-end processing run per leave plan and year: status, step, dates, employee count, initiator.

nodes.name: tenant_leave_cycle
nodes.description: One row per tenant defining the leave year (start and end month).

nodes.name: tenant_settings
nodes.description: Per-tenant feature switches formerly held in environment variables; currently only external_leave_sync_enabled.

nodes.name: wfh_admin_setting
nodes.description: A WFH policy per tenant: application rules (reason, half-day, future dates, admin-level monthly caps, prior notice, same-day cutoff) and archive flag.

nodes.name: wfh_admin_setting_type_config
nodes.description: Which WFH types a WFH admin setting (policy) offers; detaching sets is_active False instead of deleting.

nodes.name: wfh_balance
nodes.description: Current WFH allowance per employee per policy (allocated, used, remaining, unlimited flag); one active row expected per (employee, policy).

nodes.name: wfh_balance_accrual_history
nodes.description: Append-only log of WFH balance changes (accrual runs, initial grant, accrual-setting changes, admin manual edits) with old/new values and the period end the balance is valid until.

nodes.name: wfh_request
nodes.description: One row per WFH request (or per piece of a request split by partial cancel): dates, half-day session, WFH type, approval workflow state, approver/rejecter/canceller, watchers and escalation progress.

nodes.name: wfh_request_attachments
nodes.description: Links WFH requests to uploaded proof files stored in leave_file.

nodes.name: wfh_type
nodes.description: Per-tenant catalogue of WFH kinds (REGULAR, MENSTRUAL) and their rules: balance deduction, per-type monthly caps, half-day override, auto-approval, gender restriction.
